<div class="stat-table-flex pixel-art">
<div class="stat-table-flex-item">
{|
| colspan="2" style="background: none; border: none" | {{{portrait|}}}
|-
! colspan="2" style="border-width: 2px; border-radius: 5px" | {{#if:{{{sprite|}}}|[[File:Ma gba {{{sprite}}}.gif]]}} ''[[{{{classlink|{{{class}}}}}}|{{{class}}}]]''
|-
! style="border-width: 2px; border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Level]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{lv}}}
|-
! style="border-width: 2px; border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Affinity]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0; min-width: 13px" | {{#if:{{{affin|}}}|[[File:Is gba {{lc:{{{affin}}}}}affin.png|link={{{affin}}} (affinity)]]|{{nwh}}}}
|}
</div>
<div class="stat-grid">
<div class="stat-table-inner-flex">
<div class="stat-table-flex-item">
{| style="border-spacing: 3px"
! colspan="4" style="border-width: 2px; border-radius: 5px"| Stats
|-
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Max HP]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{HP|{{nwh}}}}}
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Luck]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{luck|{{nwh}}}}}
|-
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[{{#if:{{{mag|}}}|Magic (stat){{!}}Magic|Strength}}]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{str|{{{mag|{{nwh}}}}}}}}
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Defense]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{def|{{nwh}}}}}
|-
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Skill (stat)|Skill]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{skill|{{nwh}}}}}
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Resistance]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{res|{{nwh}}}}}
|-
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Speed]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{spd|{{nwh}}}}}
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Constitution]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{con|{{nwh}}}}}
|-
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Movement]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{move|{{nwh}}}}}
! style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | [[Aid]]
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{aid|{{nwh}}}}}
|}
</div>
<div class="stat-table-flex-item">
{| style="border-spacing: 3px"
! style="border-width: 2px; border-radius: 5px" | Inventory
|-
| style="text-align: left; background: none; border: none" | {{{inventory|{{nwh}}}}}
|-
| style="background: none; border: none" |
{| style="width: 100%"
|+ Weapon Levels
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px; min-width: 15px" | {{SwordGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{sw|{{nwh}}}}}
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px; min-width: 15px" | {{LanceGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{la|{{nwh}}}}}
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px; min-width: 15px" | {{AxeGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{ax|{{nwh}}}}}
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px; min-width: 15px" | {{BowGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{bo|{{nwh}}}}}
|-
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | {{AnimaGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{an|{{nwh}}}}}
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | {{LightGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{li|{{nwh}}}}}
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | {{DarkGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{da|{{nwh}}}}}
| style="border-radius: 5px 0 0 5px" | {{StaffGBA}}
| style="border-radius: 0 5px 5px 0" | {{{st|{{nwh}}}}}
|}
|}
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div><noinclude>

{{doc}}</noinclude>
